candidate_spec.high_level_variant: Slight lateral shift of a nearby parked vehicle near the intersection while keeping the same mission and signalized urban context to preserve a likely red-light conflict zone.
candidate_spec.mutation_intent: Maintain an urban, signal-controlled approach with active traffic-light states (including red) and Autoware perception/planning topics, while modestly adjusting the nearby static vehicle to test robustness of the red-light violation symptom under slightly altered spatial context without changing the fundamental route-light ambiguity.
pre_execution_validation_rules: Verify that traffic-light actors exist on the loaded map along the ego mission route and that their state stream includes at least one red phase while the ego is in motion.
Check that Autoware perception topics for detected objects and prediction objects are publishing during the time window when the ego is approaching the intersection.
Confirm that planning/final_waypoints is published continuously from spawn until at least the time the ego reaches the traffic-light-controlled region.
Ensure vehicle_status shows nonzero ego speed for some portion of the run (ego is not fully stationary for the entire scenario).
post_execution_validation_rules: Confirm that the oracle (or error report) flags a red_light violation event at least once during the run.
Verify that lane_invasion remains unconfirmed (do not require lane_invasion=true); if reported, treat it as incidental and not required for success.
Check that, around the red_light violation time, a traffic-light affecting the ego route is in red state or has just entered red in the traffic-light state logs.
Confirm that Autoware perception, prediction, and planning topics remain available (no long dropouts) up to and including the violation time.
Verify that vehicle_status indicates ego motion (speed > 0) at or before the time the oracle reports the red-light violation.
uncertainty: The precise geometric relation between the ego path, the stop line, and the relevant traffic-light remains unknown and is not enforced beyond the oracle's red_light flag.
The internal root cause (perception vs planning vs control) of the red-light violation is not constrained by this variant.
No requirement is placed on vehicle_cmd behavior beyond topic presence; mismatches with vehicle_status are not interpreted as causal evidence.

note: Generated candidate scenario JSON for local DriveFuzz execution. It has not been executed in CARLA/Autoware.
